title: fix(spec): record page descriptions no longer claim a key-field strip or stage path
body:

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuVwX4pUdM1qvNLSqRZNSvv3)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgW85kwjGaz7HqsmEuv

Fixes #35943

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up #35942 (`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md` still says `highlightFields` draws a strip and `stageField` a stage path; a skills-lane card). This PR touches no `skills/**` file.

## 维护者速读
- 用户无感：页面不变，只是 Studio 帮助文字、字段说明和开发者文档不再说详情页顶部有关键字段条或阶段条；阶段在记录名旁的状态标签上。
- 属于「记录详情页重做」专题的收尾：去掉阶段条和关键字段条之后，留下的说明文字跟着改对。
- 出错时只会是说明文字不准，不影响数据和页面行为；整个改动可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

Since #35938 the default record page (`buildDefaultPageSchema`) draws no key-field strip (`record:highlights`) and no stage path (`record:path`); the stage is the status tag beside the record name. These texts still said otherwise:

- **`@objectstack/spec`**: the `highlightFields` JSDoc and describe now name what it drives (default list and related-list columns, cards, hover cards, previews, the record picker) and say the default record page draws no strip from it. The `stageField` JSDoc says the header's status tag reads it. The `RECORD_HIGHLIGHTS_MAX` JSDoc says the count cuts only a strip a page places in its `highlights` slot, and no longer says the `field-group-shadowed` lint reads it (it stopped in #35938). The upgrade-guide entry `field-group-shadowed-six-highlights` keeps saying what the 18.x step was, but its `reason`, `replacement` and `acceptanceCriteria` now say the warning judges the record title alone: a group emptied by highlights alone no longer warns, and no action is owed. The Studio help text of `highlightFields` (`object.form.ts`) and the liveness ledger note say the same. The generated references are regenerated.
- **`@objectstack/platform-objects`**: the `highlightFields` help text in all ten translated metadata-form locales carries the new sentence. `en.metadata-forms.generated.ts` is regenerated, not hand-edited.
- **`@objectstack/lint`**: the `os explain` text of `object-field-ref-unknown` and `semantic-role-field-unprovisioned`, and the `validate-object-field-refs` header, name the hover card and the record picker in place of the strip. The explain pin in `validate-object-field-refs.test.ts` follows the new sentence.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-detail`**: the `record:details` `hideFields` description no longer says the synth pipeline fills it; the key is still accepted. `sdui.manifest.json` and `content/docs/ui/components/record.mdx` are regenerated from it. Comments in `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`, `record-details.tsx` and the README follow.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`**: Studio's lifecycle-field help (`engine.studio.settings.stageField`, `stageNone`, en and zh) talks about the status tag, not a progress bar.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`** (the one code change): the phone path no longer passes `phoneRecordHeader(...).highlightFields` to `buildDefaultPageSchema`, and the desktop path no longer passes `synthParts.highlightFields`. `buildDefaultPageSchema` never reads `options.highlightFields`: only `buildDefaultHighlights` reads it, and a slotted page's `highlights` slot is pushed as authored. So the page is the same. The phone subtitle is unchanged.
- **`@object-ui/types`**: the page `highlights` slot doc (`layout.ts`) says the slot places a strip the synthesized default does not draw. It ships in the package's `.d.ts`, so the changeset carries a patch entry.
- **Comments only** (nothing published): `@object-ui/fields` `RecordHoverCard.tsx`, the semantic-zoo and account showcase objects, three app-crm objects, `sys-record-share.object.ts`, the dogfood test and the `sys_email` audit test.

Out of scope, as dispatched: retiring `BuildPageOptions.highlightFields / .statusField / .stages`. Their JSDoc is as #35938 left it.

## Tests

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

All at tree `fd4c5841`, the same tree as head `6c5199bb`, which only rewords the commit trailer. Run through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (VERDICT command-exit 0 each):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: Test Files 222 passed (222), Tests 9350 passed (9350); `typecheck` green.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/component.test.ts src/data/object.test.ts`: 2 files, 584 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: 125 files, 2094 tests passed; `typecheck` green.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` over the app-shell phone and record-page tests (`recordPagePush-27058`, `RecordDetailView.phoneFace-27058`, `RecordDetailView.phoneOwnerLine-28909`), `ObjectSettingsPanel.sharedSelect-11865`, `packages/i18n/` and `packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/`: 125 files, 2235 passed, 13 skipped.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/`: 115 files, 1194 tests passed. `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/i18n` `type-check` green.
- `@object-ui/app-shell`: `tsc --noEmit` green after building its dependency closure. The `tsconfig.test.json` half is left to CI because this diff touches no app-shell test file.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 172 files passed, 2 skipped; 5111 tests passed.
- Regenerated: `gen:docs` (3 reference pages), `check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` (en metadata-form bundle; `pnpm check:i18n` OK), `gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` and `gen-sdui-reference.mjs`. After the build, `check:generated` reports nothing stale.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`): all 135 ran; the `--ran` reconciliation shows 135 accounted, 134 run, 1 NOT MEASURED. NOT MEASURED: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`, because its pinned positive control is outside this shallow clone (exit 3). It is a checker-health self-test.
- Ablation: none. The one code change drops an option the builder never reads (only `buildDefaultHighlights` reads `options.highlightFields`), so no tested behaviour moved.

- Fix round 1 at `bf7ff1ee` (L1-c 7056805574): spec build, then `vitest run src/migrations/` 5 files / 198 tests passed; cli `migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts` (integration tier) 1 file / 3 tests passed; spec `check:spec-changes`, `check:upgrade-guide`, `check:generated`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:changeset-fixed`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:issue-citations` all exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `PhoneRecordHeader.highlightFields` and `PHONE_HIGHLIGHTS_MAX` (`recordPhoneHeader.ts`) now have no production reader; only `recordPagePush-27058.test.tsx` reads them. They stay here so this PR changes no behaviour and drops no pinned assertion. The module doc says so.
- `examples/app-showcase/e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts` still expects the stage path and the `Record highlights` strip on the semantic-zoo default page. This run did not execute it: it needs a live showcase and is not wired to CI. Read from the source, it would fail at its first stage-path assertion.
- Studio's highlight-field editor (`HighlightFieldsEditor.tsx`) still draws a "Highlight strip preview", "as the record page will show it". The default record page draws no strip. That label and the preview are UI behaviour, not description text, so they are left for a separate card.
- `docs/adr/0085-*.md` ("the detail highlight strip consumes `highlightFields`") is a governed surface and is not touched.
- The pending `.changeset/35252-field-group-shadowed-six-highlights.md` (unreleased) is left as written; this PR does not edit another PR's changeset.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`: the `buildDefaultPageSchema` call. This is the one non-comment code hunk; check that nothing else reads the dropped option.
2. `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/*.metadata-forms.generated.ts`: the hand-written locale sentences.
3. `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`: the `highlightFields` describe.

Two-minute check: `git grep -n 'detail highlight strip' -- packages/spec/src packages/platform-objects/src packages/lint/src ui/packages/plugin-detail/src sdui.manifest.json` prints nothing. On `main` it prints the spec describe and JSDoc, the Studio help text and its English bundle copy.

Left as written: `InterfaceListPage.tsx`, `objectViewTabs.ts` and two tests still call "the detail highlight strip" the first consumer of `highlightFields` when they explain why it is not a column list. That is about a strip a page places, not the default page.
